description: This file is a PHP test class for the PerformanceReviewAPI, specifically testing the API endpoints related to performance reviews such as getAll, getOne, create, update, and delete. It uses various test utilities and mocks to validate API behavior within the OrangeHRM project.

classes.name: PerformanceReviewAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the PerformanceReviewAPI endpoints, including getAll, delete, create, update, and getOne.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of all performance reviews using the API.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deletion of a performance review via the API.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests creating a new performance review via the API.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an existing performance review via the API.

methods.description: Tests retrieving a single performance review via the API.
